column13:
The study has a trial registration, only clinical pregnancy was listed as an outcome.    

Pregnancy loss was not a registered outcome, and it appears that the definition of 'pregnancy loss' used the denominator of pregnancy with sacs rather than clinical pregnancy (with heart beat) which could have been a post-hoc decision. We are not able to overcome this limitation as it's not clear how many losses of pregnancies with a heartbeat occurred.

Authors have conducted a complex data analysis, reporting only percentages, and absolute numbers were not given and instead were back-calculated from the percentages provided.

The use of hyaluronan in sperm selection for ICSI. Use of hyaluronan-facilitated sperm selection did not therefore exert any observed harmful effects to the recipient oocytes or resulting embryos." It seems the authors wished for the results to be favourable towards PICSI.
